evidence.observation: H701 temperature reads 411.707 °C, far above the other reboiler heater and vessel.
T701 has risen to 418.299 °C while T702 is 61.333 °C and T703 is 51.202 °C; the isolated high, rising reading suggests a sensor fault or localized heater overheating, not established bulk heating.
System pressure is 199.327 mbar, column temperatures T711/T712 are 44.483/44.354 °C, and cooling-water flow is 3.902; these channels do not show a corresponding excursion.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature measurement, heater power/setpoint and permitted temperature limits are needed to distinguish actual overheating from thermocouple drift or another measurement fault. Composition measurements and the separation target are needed to assess separation.
